payload.title: The rating agent's daily review names each Story and is answered row by row
payload.description: Live review rr-ratings-2026-11-27 on machines-on-machines said only '1 rating suggested, 0 five-star candidates' with generic Accept/Reject: no Story, stars or reason. Fix: the review's story links carry title, suggested stars, five-star flag and the agent's reason; the console lists each Story with Use N stars / other stars / Leave it (rating via setItemStars as the person), the review resolves when every row is answered or dismissed; reviews show and stories show print them; Today names the Stories.
